19.34.d: जाङ्गिडो॒ ऽसि जङ्गिडो॒ र॒क्षितासि जङ्गिदः॒ । द्विपा॒च् च॒तुष्पाद् अस्मा॒कं स॒र्वं रक्षतु जङ्गिदः॒ ॥१॥
19.34.e: Jangida, thou art Angiras: thou art a guardian, Jangida. Let Jangida, keep safely all our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

19.34.d: या॒ गृ॒त्स्यस् त्रिपञ्चाशीः॒ शतं॒ कृत्याकृ॒तश् च ये॒ । स॒र्वान् विनक्तु ते॒जसो ऽरसां॒ जङ्गिद॒स् करत् ॥२॥
19.34.e: Dice-witcheries, the fifty-threes, the hundred witchcraft-practi- sers, All these may Jangida make weak, bereft of their effectual force.

19.34.d: अरसं॒ कृत्रि॒मं नाद॒म् अरसाः सप्त॒ वि॒स्रसः । अ॒पेतो॒ जङ्गिडा॒मतिम् इ॒षुम् अ॒स्तेव शातय ॥३॥
19.34.e: Baffle the loud factitious howl, make impotent the seven decays. As when an archer speeds the shaft, drive away want, O Jangida,

19.34.d: कृत्यादू॒षण एवा॒य॒म् अ॒थो अरातिदू॒षणः । अ॒थो स॒हस्वाञ् जङ्गिडः॒ प्र॒ न आ॒युम्षि तारिषत् ॥४॥
19.34.e: This counteracts the sorceress, this banishes malignity: Then may victorious Jangida's prolong the days we have to live.

19.34.d: स॒ जङ्गिड॒स्य महिमा॒ प॒रि णः पातु विश्व॒तः । वि॒ष्कन्धं ये॒न सास॒ह सं॒स्कन्धम् ओ॒ज ओ॒जसा ॥५॥
19.34.e: Let Jangida's protecting might encompass us on every side. Wherewith he quells Vishkandha and Sanskandha, might by greater might.

19.34.d: त्रि॒ष् ट्वा देवा॒ अजनयन् नि॒ष्ठितं भू॒म्याम् अ॒धि । त॒म् उ त्वा॒ङ्गिरा इ॒ति ब्राह्मणाः॒ पूर्व्या॒ विदुः ॥६॥
19.34.e: Three times the Gods engendered thee fixt on the surface of the earth; The Brāhmans of the olden time knew that thy name was Angiras;

19.34.d: न॒ त्वा पू॒र्वा ओ॒षधयो न॒ त्वा तरन्ति या॒ न॒वाः । वि॒बाध उग्रो॒ जङ्गिडः॒ परिपा॒णः सुमङ्ग॒लः ॥७॥
19.34.e: The ancient plants surpass thee not, nor any herbs of recent days. A potent charm is Jangida, a most felicitous defence.

19.34.d: अ॒थोपदान भगवो जा॒ङ्गिडा॒मितवीर्य । पुरा॒ त उग्रा॒ ग्रसत उ॒पे॒न्द्रो वीर्यं॑ ददौ ॥८॥
19.34.e: Then when thou sprangest into life, Jangida of un-measured strength, Indra, O mighty One, bestowed great power upon thee from the first.

19.34.d: उग्र॒ इ॒त् ते वनस्पत इ॒न्द्र ओज्मा॒नम् आ॒ दधौ । अ॒मीवाः स॒र्वाश् चात॒यं जहि॒ र॒क्षांस्य् ओषधे ॥९॥
19.34.e: To thee in truth, O Forest Tree, Indra the mighty One gave strength. Driving away all maladies, strike thou the demons down, O Plant.

19.34.d: आ॒शरीकं वि॒शरीकं बला॒सं पृष्ट्यामय॒म् । तक्मा॒नं विश्व॒शारदम् अरसां॒ जङ्गिड॒स् करत् ॥१०॥
19.34.e: Lumbago and rheumatic pain, consumptive cough, and pleurisy, And fever which each Autumn brings, may Jangida make- powerless.

19.35.d: इ॒न्द्रस्य ना॒म गृह्ण॒न्त ऋ॒सयो जङ्गिदं॒ ददुः । देवा॒ यं॒ चक्रु॒र् भेषज॒म् अ॒ग्रे विष्कन्धदू॒षणम् ॥१॥
19.35.e: While their lips uttered Indra's name the Rishis gave us Jangida.. Which in the earliest time Gods made a remedy, Vishkandha's- cure.

19.35.d: स॒ नो रक्षतु जङ्गिडो॒ धनपालो॒ ध॒नेव । देवा॒ यं॒ चक्रु॒र् ब्राह्मणाः॒ परिपा॒णम् अरातिह॒म् ॥२॥
19.35.e: So may this Jangida guard us, even as a treasurer guards wealth,. Even this which Gods and Brāhmans made a malice-quelling sure defence.

19.35.d: दुर्हा॒र्दः सं॒घोरं च॒क्षुः पापकृ॒त्वानम् आ॒गमम् । तां॒स् त्वं॒ सहस्रचक्षो प्रतीबोधे॒न नाशय परिपा॒णो ऽसि जङ्गिडः॒ ॥३॥
19.35.e: Hard-hearted men, the cruel eye, the sinner who hath come to- us, Destroy thou these with watchful care, O thou who hast a. thousand eyes. Thou, Jangida, art my defence.

19.35.d: प॒रि मा दिवः॒ प॒रि मा पृथिव्याः॒ प॒र्य् अन्त॒रिक्षात् प॒रि मा वीरु॒द्भ्यः । प॒रि मा भूता॒त् प॒रि मोत॒ भ॒व्याद् दिशो॒दिशो जङ्गिडः॒ पात्व् अस्मा॒न् ॥४॥
19.35.e: Guard me from earth and guard me from the heavens, guard me from middle air, from plants protect me. Protect me from the present and the future. From every region Jangida preserve us!

19.35.d: य॒ ऋष्ण॒वो देव॒कृता य॒ उतो॒ ववृते॒ ऽन्यः॒ । स॒र्वां स्ता॒न् विश्व॒भेषजो ऽरसां॒ जङ्गिड॒स् करत् ॥५॥
19.35.e: All sorcerers made by the Gods, all that arise from mortal men,. These, one and all, let Jangida, healer of all, make impotent.

19.36.d: शत॒वारो अनीनशद् य॒क्ष्मान् र॒क्षांसि ते॒जसा । आरो॒हन् व॒र्चसा सह॒ मणि॒र् दुर्णामचा॒तनः ॥१॥
19.36.e: The Hundred-haired hath banished hence fiends and Consump- tions by its might. With splendour hath the charm that scares demons of ill-name mounted up.

19.36.d: शृ॒ङ्गाभ्यां र॒क्षो नुदते मू॒लेन यातुधान्यः॑ । म॒ध्येन य॒क्ष्मं बाधते नै॒नं पाप्मा॒ति तत्रति ॥२॥
19.36.e: It drives off demons with its horns and sorceresses with its root, It stays Consumption with its waist: from this no wickedness escapes.

19.36.d: ये॒ य॒क्ष्मासो अर्भका॒ महा॒न्तो ये॒ च शब्दि॒नः । स॒र्वां दुर्णामहा॒ मणिः॒ शत॒वारो अनीनशत् ॥३॥
19.36.e: Consumptions, light and serious, and those which sounds accompany, All these the Amulet, Hundred-haired, scarer of fiends, hath banished hence.

19.36.d: शतं॒ वीरा॒न् अजनयच् छतं॒ य॒क्ष्मान् अ॒पावपत् । दुर्णा॒म्नः स॒र्वान् हत्वा॒व र॒क्षांसि धूनुते ॥४॥
19.36.e: A hundred men hath it produced, hundred Consumptions chased away, All fiends of evil-name it hath smitten, and shakes the Rākshasas.

19.36.d: हि॒रण्यशृङ्ग ऋषभः॒ शातवारो॒ अयं॒ मणिः॒ । दुर्णा॒म्नः स॒र्वांस् तृध्वा॒व र॒क्षांस्य् अक्रमीत् ॥५॥
19.36.e: The Bull that weareth horns of gold, this Amulet with hundred hairs, Hath cleft the demons of ill-name and overcome the Rākshasas.

19.36.d: शत॒म् अहं॒ दुर्णा॒म्नीनां गन्धर्वाप्सर॒सां शत॒म् । शत॒म् शश्वन्व॒तीनां शत॒वारेण वारये ॥६॥
19.36.e: Hundred she-fiends, a hundred of Gandharvas and Apsarasas, A hundred of dog-mated nymphs, I keep away with Hundred- Hair

19.37.d: इदं॒ व॒र्चो अग्नि॒ना दत्त॒म् आ॒गन् भ॒र्गो य॒शः स॒ह ओ॒जो व॒यो ब॒लम् । त्र॒यस्त्रिंशद् या॒नि च वीर्या॑णि ता॒न्य् अग्निः॒ प्र॒ ददातु मे ॥१॥
19.37.e: To me hath come this word given by Agni, fame, force and might, and strength, and life, and lustre. May Agni too bestow on me three-times a hundred manly powers.

19.37.d: व॒र्च आ॒ धेहि मे तन्वां॑ स॒ह ओ॒जो व॒यो ब॒लम् । इन्द्रिया॒य त्वा क॒र्मणे वीर्या॑य प्र॒ति गृह्णामि शत॒शारदाय ॥२॥
19.37.e: For mighty strength, for action, I receive thee, for manly power, to last a hundred autumns.

19.37.d: ऊर्जे॒ त्वा ब॒लाय त्वौ॒जसे स॒हसे त्वा । अभिभू॒याय त्वा राष्ट्रभृ॒त्याय प॒र्य् ऊहामि शत॒शारदाय ॥३॥
19.37.e: For conquering strength and energy and vigour I fasten thee for chieftainship, for bearing royal dominion through a hundred autumns.

19.37.d: ऋतु॒भ्यष् ट्वार्तवे॒भ्यो माद्भ्यः॒ संवत्सरे॒भ्यः । धात्रे॒ विधात्रे॒ समृ॒धे भूत॒स्य प॒तये यजे ॥४॥
19.37.e: With Seasons and with Season-groups, for vigour and extended life. With splendour of the perfect year we fasten thee about the neck.

19.38.d: न॒ तं॒ य॒क्ष्मा अ॒रुन्धते नै॒नं शप॒थो अश्नुते । यं॒ भेषज॒स्य गुल्गुलोः॒ सुरभि॒र् गन्धो॒ अश्नुते॒ ॥१॥
19.38.e: Never Consumption, never curse touches the man, Arundhatī! Whom the delicious odour of the healing Bdellium penetrates

19.38.d: वि॒ष्वञ्चस् त॒स्माद् य॒क्ष्मा मृगा॒ अ॒श्वा इवेरते । य॒द् गुल्गुलु॒ सैन्धवं॒ य॒द् वा॒प्य् अ॒सि समुद्रि॒यम् ॥२॥
19.38.e: Consumptions flee apart from it as from a wild beast fly the deer. If thou, O Bdellium, art produced from Sindhu or hast come from sea, The quality of both have I taken to keep this man unscathed.

19.39.d: ऐ॒तु देव॒स् त्रा॒यमाणः कु॒ष्ठो हिम॒वतस् प॒रि । तक्मा॒नं स॒र्वं नाशय स॒र्वाश् च यातुधान्यः॑ ॥१॥
19.39.e: Let Kushtha from the Hill of Snow come, a divine deliverer. Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses far away.

19.39.d: त्री॒णि ते कुष्ठ ना॒मानि नद्यमारो॒ नद्या॒रिषः । न॒द्यायं॒ पु॒रुषो रिषत् । य॒स्मै परिब्र॒वीमि त्वा सायं॒प्रातर् अ॒थो दि॒वा ॥२॥
19.39.e: Kushtha, three several names hast thou, Naghamāra, Naghārisha: let not mishap befall this man, For whom I make a charm of thee at eve, at morning, and by day.

19.39.d: जीवला॒ ना॒म ते माता॒ जीवन्तो॒ ना॒म ते पिता॒ । न॒द्यायं॒ पु॒रुषो रिषत् । य॒स्मै परिब्र॒वीमि त्वा सायं॒प्रातर् अ॒थो दि॒वा ॥३॥
19.39.e: Jivalā is thy mother's name, thy father's name is Jivala; let not mishap, etc.

19.39.d: उत्तमो॒ अस्य् ओ॒षधीनाम् अनड्वा॒न् ज॒गताम् इव व्याघ्रः॒ श्व॒पदाम् इव । न॒द्यायं॒ पु॒रुषो रिषत् । य॒स्मै परिब्र॒वीमि त्वा सायं॒प्रातर् अ॒थो दिवा ॥४॥
19.39.e: Thou art the best amid the plants, even as the ox is best of tame, the tiger of rapacious beasts: let not mishap, etc.

19.39.d: त्रिः॒ शा॒म्बुभ्यो अ॒ङ्गिरेभ्यस् त्रि॒र् आदित्ये॒भ्यस् प॒रि । त्रि॒र् जातो॒ विश्व॒देवेभ्यः । स॒ कु॒ष्ठो विश्व॒भेषजः साकं॒ सो॒मेन तिष्ठति ।
19.39.e: Born thrice from the Ādityas, thrice from Bhrigus, thrice from Angiras' sons, born from the Visve Devas thrice, Healer of every malady, that Kushtha stands by Soma's side. Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses far away.

19.39.d: अश्वत्थो॒ देवस॒दनस् तृती॒यस्याम् इतो॒ दिवि॒ । त॒त्रामृ॒तस्य च॒क्षणं त॒तः कु॒ष्ठो अजायत । स॒ कु॒ष्ठो विश्व॒भेषजः साकं॒ सो॒मेन तिष्ठति ।
19.39.e: In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods: There is embodiment of life that dies not: thence was Kushtha born.

19.39.d: हिरण्य॒यी नौ॒र् अचरद् धि॒रण्यबन्धना दिवि॒ । त॒त्रामृ॒तस्य च॒क्षणं त॒तः कु॒ष्ठो अजायत । स॒ कु॒ष्ठो विश्व॒भेषजः साकं॒ सो॒मेन तिष्ठति ।
19.39.e: There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold: There is embodiment of life that dies not; thence was Kushtha born.

19.39.d: य॒त्र ना॒वप्रभ्रं॒शनं य॒त्र हिम॒वतः शि॒रः । त॒त्रामृ॒तस्य च॒क्षणं त॒तः कु॒ष्ठो अजायत । स॒ कुष्ठो विश्व॒भेषजः साकं॒ सो॒मेन तिष्ठति ।
19.39.e: Where is the Sinking of the Ship, the summit of the Hill of Snow, There is embodiment of life that dies not: thence was Kustha born. Healer of every malady, that Kushtha stands by Soma's side. Banish thou all Consumption, drive all sorceresses far away.

19.39.d: यं॒ त्वा वे॒द पू॒र्व इ॒क्ष्वाको यं॒ वा त्वा कुष्ठ काम्यः॑ । यं॒ वा व॒सो य॒म् आ॒त्स्यस् ते॒नासि विश्व॒भेषजः ॥९॥
19.39.e: Thou whom Ikshvāku's ancestor, whom he who well-loved Kushtha, knew, Whom Vāyasa and Mātsya knew, hence healer of all ills art thou.

19.39.d: शीर्षशोकं॒ तृ॒तीयकं सदंदि॒र् य॒श् च हायनः॒ । तक्मा॒नं विश्वधावीर्याधरा॒ञ्चं प॒रा सुव ॥१०॥
19.39.e: O thou who hast all-reaching might drive away Fever, drive it down, Head racking Fever, tertian, continual, lasting for a year.

19.40.d: य॒न् मे छिद्रं॒ म॒नसो य॒च् च वाचः॒ स॒रस्वती मन्युम॒न्तं जगा॒म । वि॒श्वैस् त॒द् देवैः॒ सह॒ संविदानः॒ सं॒ दधातु बृ॒हस्प॒तिः ॥१॥
19.40.e: For each defect of mine in voice and spirit I have approached One vehement and ardent. With all the Deities, fully approving, Brihaspati supply the want!

19.40.d: मा॒ न आपो मेधां॒ मा॒ ब्र॒ह्म प्र॒ मथिष्टन । सुष्यदा॒ यूयं॒ स्यन्दध्वम् उ॒पहूतो ऽहं॒ सुमे॒धा वर्चस्वी॒ ॥२॥
19.40.e: Disturb ye not our intellect, O Waters, nor the power of prayer_ Glide on your way, strength-giving, invocated: may I be vigor- ous and wise.

19.40.d: मा॒ नो मेधां॒ मा॒ नो दीक्षां॒ मा॒ नो हिंसिष्टं य॒त् त॒पः । शिवा॒ नः शं॒ सन्त्व् आ॒युषे शिवा॒ भवन्तु मात॒रः ॥३॥
19.40.e: Mar not our consecrating rite, our intellect, or fervent zeal. Gracious to us for lengthened life, propitious let the Mothers be.

19.40.d: या॒ नः पी॒परद् अश्वि॒ना ज्यो॒तिष्मती त॒मस् तिरः॒ । ता॒म् अस्मे॒ रासताम् इ॒षम् ॥४॥
19.40.e: Vouchsafe to us, ye Asvins twain, such strength as, with atten- dant light, May through the darkness carry us.

19.41.d: भद्र॒म् इछ॒न्त ऋ॒षयः स्वर्वि॒दस् त॒पो दीक्षा॒म् उपनि॒षेदुर् अ॒ग्रे । त॒तो राष्ट्रं॒ ब॒लम् ओ॒जश् च जातं॒ त॒द् अस्मै देवा॒ उपसं॒नमन्तु ॥१॥
19.41.e: Desiring bliss, at first, light-finding Rishis began religious rite and holy fervour. Thence energy was born, and might, and kingship: so to this man let gathered Gods incline them.

19.42.d: ब्र॒ह्म हो॒ता ब्र॒ह्म यज्ञा॒ ब्र॒ह्मणा स्व॒रवो मिताः॒ । अध्वर्यु॒र् ब्र॒ह्मणो जातो॒ ब्र॒ह्मणो ऽन्त॒र्हितं हविः॒ ॥१॥
19.42.e: Brahma is Hotar, sacrifice: with Brahma are the stakes set up. From Brahma was the Adhvaryu born, from Brahma hidden offering.

19.42.d: ब्र॒ह्म स्रु॒चो घृत॒वतीर् ब्र॒ह्मणा वे॒दिर् उ॒द्धिता । ब्र॒ह्म यज्ञ॒स्य त॒त्त्वं च ऋत्वि॒जो ये॒ हविष्कृ॒तः । शमिता॒य स्वा॒हा ॥२॥
19.42.e: Brahma is fatness-dropping scoops: with Brahma was the altar reared. Brahma is worship, lengthened rite, the Rishis who pay sacrifice, the victim's Immolators. Hail!

19.42.d: अंहोमु॒चे प्र॒ भरे मनीषा॒म् आ॒ सुत्रा॒व्णे सुमति॒म् आवृणानः॒ । इम॒म् इन्द्र प्र॒ति हव्यं॒ गृभा॒य सत्याः॒ सन्तु य॒जमानस्य का॒माः ॥३॥
19.42.e: To him who frees from woe mine hymn I offer, to the Good Guardian, as I seek his favour. Accept this offering of mine, O Indra. Fulfilled be all the sacri- ficer's wishes!

19.42.d: अंहोमु॒चं व्र्षभं॒ यज्ञि॒यानां विरा॒जन्तं प्रथम॒म् अध्वरा॒णम् । अपां॒ न॒पातम् अश्वि॒ना हुवे धि॒य इन्द्रिये॒ण त इन्द्रियं॒ दत्तम् ओ॒जः ॥४॥
19.42.e: With prayer I call on him who frees from trouble, Prince of Gods, Splendid, chief of sacrifices, I call the Waters' Child and both the Asvins, Vigour is mine, and strength bestowed by Indra.

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । अग्नि॒र् मा त॒त्र नयत्व् अग्नि॒र् मेधा॒ दधातु मे । अग्न॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥१॥
19.43.e: Whither men versed in Brahma go, with fervour and the cleans- ing rite, Thither let Agni lead me, let Agni give me intelligence, All hail to Agni!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । वायु॒र् मा त॒त्र नयतु वायुः॒ प्रणा॒न् दधातु मे वाय॒वे स्वा॒हा ॥२॥
19.43.e: Whither etc. Thither let Vāyu lead me, let Vāyu vouchsafe me vital breath. All hail to Vāyu!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । सू॒र्यो मा त॒त्र नयतु च॒क्षुः सू॒र्यो दधातु मे । सू॒र्याय स्वा॒हा ॥३॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither let Sūrya lead me, let Sūrya vouchsafe me power of sight. All hail to Sürya

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । चन्द्रो॒ मा त॒त्र नयतु म॒नश् चन्द्रो॒ दधातु मे । चन्द्रा॒य स्वा॒हा ॥४॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither let Chandra lead me, let Chandra vouchsafe me intellect. All hail to Chandra!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । सो॒मो मा त॒त्र नयतु प॒यः सो॒मो दधातु मे । सो॒माय स्वा॒हा ॥५॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither let Soma lead me, let Soma vouchsafe me vital sap. All hail to Soma!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो यान्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । इ॒न्द्रो मा त॒त्र नयतु ब॒लम् इ॒न्द्रो दधातु मे । इ॒न्द्राय स्वा॒हा ॥६॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither let Indra lead me, let Indra bestow upon me power. All hail to Indra!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । आ॒पो मा त॒त्र नयत्व् अमृ॒तम् मो॒प तिष्ठतु । अद्भ्यः॒ स्वा॒हा ॥७॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither, let Waters lead me, let the Waters give me deathless life. All hail to Waters!

19.43.d: य॒त्र ब्रह्मवि॒दो या॒न्ति दीक्ष॒या त॒पसा सह॒ । ब्रह्मा॒ मा त॒त्र नयतु ब्रह्मा॒ ब्र॒ह्म दधातु मे । ब्रह्म॒णे स्वा॒हा ॥८॥
19.43.e: Whither, etc. Thither let Brahma lead me, let Brahma give Brahma unto me. All hail to Brahma!

19.44.d: आ॒युषो ऽसि प्रत॒रणं वि॒प्रं भेषज॒म् उच्यसे । त॒द् आञ्जन त्वं॒ शंताते श॒म् आ॒पो अ॒भयं कृतम् ॥१॥
19.44.e: Thou art the lengthening of life, thy name is Universal Cure: Then, Ointment! send felicity; Waters, send happiness and peace.

19.44.d: यो॒ हरिमा॒ जाया॒न्यो ऽङ्गभेदो॒ विष॒ल्पकः । स॒र्वं ते य॒क्ष्मम् अ॒ङ्गेभ्यो बहि॒र् नि॒र् हन्त्व् आ॒ञ्जनम् ॥२॥
19.44.e: The yellow hue, the feverish heat, the shooting pain that rends II the limbs, All the consumptive malady let the Ointment drive from out thy frame.

19.44.d: आ॒ञ्जनं पृथिव्यां॒ जातं॒ भद्रं॒ पुरुषजी॒वनम् । कृणो॒त्व् अ॒प्रमायुकं र॒थजूतिम् अ॒नागसम् ॥३॥
19.44.e: Let the Salve born upon the earth, benignant, giving life to man. Make the swift rider on the car sinless, exempt from sudden death.

19.44.d: प्रा॒ण प्राणं॒ त्रायस्वासो अ॒सवे मृड । नि॒रृते नि॒रृत्या नः पा॒शेभ्यो मुञ्च ॥४॥
19.44.e: Preserve our breath, O Vital Breath, have mercy on our life, O Life. From snares of Nirriti do thou, O Nirriti, deliver us.

19.44.d: सि॒न्धोर् ग॒र्भो ऽसि विद्यु॒तां पु॒ष्पम् । वातः प्राणः॒ सू॒र्यश् च॒क्षुर् दिव॒स् प॒यः ॥५॥
19.44.e: Thou art the babe of Sindhu, thou art lightnings' flower, wind, breath, and Sun: thou art the eye and milk of heaven.

19.44.d: दे॒वाञ्जन त्रै॒ककुद प॒रि मा पाहि विश्व॒तः । न॒ त्वा तरन्त्य् ओ॒षधयो बा॒ह्याः पर्वती॒या उत॒ ॥६॥
19.44.e: Gods' Ointment from the Three Peaked Hill, preserve thou me on every side. No plants of earth surpass thee, none from mountain or from cultured ground.

19.44.d: वी॒दं॒ म॒ध्यम् अ॒वासृपद् रक्षोहा॒मीवचा॒तनः । अ॒मीवाः स॒र्वाश् चात॒यन् नाश॒यद् अभिभा॒ इतः॒ ॥७॥
19.44.e: Now hath it gently crept within, fiend-slaying, chasing malady. And driving all diseases hence, and evil omens, banished them.

19.44.d: बह्व् इ॑दं॒ राजन् वरुणा॒नृतम् आह पू॒रुषः । त॒स्मात् सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च॒ नः प॒र्य् अं॒हसः ॥८॥
19.44.e: Full many a falsehood, O thou King Varuna, man hath uttered here: Do thou who hast a thousand powers preserve us from that misery.

19.44.d: य॒द् आपो अघ्न्या॒ इ॒ति व॒रुणे॒ति य॒द् ऊचिम॒ । त॒स्मात् सहस्रवीर्य मुञ्च॒ नः प॒र्य् अं॒हसः ॥९॥
19.44.e: If we have cried, O Waters! Cows! if we have cried, O Varuna! For this endowed with thousand powers! deliver us from misery.

19.44.d: मित्र॒श् च त्वा व॒रुणश् चानुप्रे॒यतुर् आञ्जन । तौ॒ त्वानुग॒त्य दूरं॒ भोगा॒य पु॒नर् ओ॒हतुः ॥१०॥
19.44.e: Mitra and Varuna, O Salve have closely followed after thee May they, when they have followed thee afar, restore thee for our use.

19.45.d: ऋणा॒द् ऋण॒म् इव सं॒ नय कृत्यां॒ कृत्याकृ॒तो गृह॒म् । च॒क्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हा॒र्दः पृष्टी॒र् अ॒पि शृणाञ्जन ॥१॥
19.45.e: As debt from debt repay and send sorcery to the sorcerer's house. Split, Salve! the cruel villain's ribs whose evil eye bewitches us.

19.45.d: य॒द् अस्मा॒सु दुष्व॒प्न्यं य॒द् गो॒षु य॒च् च नो गृहे॒ । अ॒नामगस् तं॒ च दुर्हा॒र्दः प्रियः॒ प्र॒ति मुञ्चताम् ॥२॥
19.45.e: Whatever evil dream we have, what'er befall our kine or home, Be this that is salubrity, the evil-hearted's foe applied.

19.45.d: अपा॒म् ऊर्ज॒ ओ॒जसो वावृधान॒म् अग्ने॒र् जात॒म् अ॒धि जात॒वेदसः । च॒तुर्वीरं पर्वती॒यं य॒द् आ॒ञ्जनं दि॒शः प्रदिशः करद् इ॒च् छिवा॒स् ते ॥३॥
19.45.e: Increasing from the Waters' strength and vigour, sprung into life from Agni Jātavedas, Strong as four heroes, mountain born, this Ointment make for thee quarters and mind-points auspicious!

19.45.d: च॒तुर्वीरं बध्यत आ॒ञ्जनं ते स॒र्वा दि॒शो अ॒भयास् ते भवन्तु । ध्रुव॒स् तिष्ठासि सविते॒व चा॒र्य इमा॒ वि॒शो अभि॒ हरन्तु ते बलि॒म् ॥४॥
19.45.e: On thee is laid the Chaturvira Ointment: let all the regions give thee peace and safety. Secure like precious Savitar thou standest: to thee let all these regions bring their tribute.

19.45.d: आ॒क्ष्वै॒कं मणि॒म् ए॒कं क्र्णुष्व स्नाह्य् ए॒केना॒ पिबै॒कम् एषाम् । च॒तुर्वीरं नैरृते॒भ्यश् चतु॒र्भ्यो ग्रा॒ह्या बन्धे॒भ्यः प॒रि पात्व् अस्मा॒न् ॥५॥
19.45.e: Make one thy salve, thine amulet another, drink one, and with another bathe thy body. So let the Chaturvira keep us guarded from the four bonds of Nirriti and Grāhi.

19.45.d: अग्नि॒र् माग्नि॒नावतु प्राणा॒यापाना॒या॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे । ते॒जसे स्वस्त॒ये सुभूत॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥६॥
19.45.e: May Agni protect me with fire for inspiration and expiration, for strength, for energy, for vigour, for weal and prosperity. All Hail!

19.45.d: इ॒न्द्रो मेन्द्रिये॒णावतु प्राणा॒यापाना॒या॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे । ते॒जसे स्वस्त॒ये सुभूत॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥७॥
19.45.e: May Indra protect me with his Indra-power for inspiration, etc.

19.45.d: सो॒मो मा सौ॒म्येनावतु प्राणा॒यापाना॒या॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे । ते॒जसे स्वस्त॒ये सुभूत॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥८॥
19.45.e: May Soma protect me with Soma-power, etc.

19.45.d: भ॒गो म भ॒गेनावतु प्राणा॒यापाना॒या॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे । ते॒जसे स्वस्त॒ये सुभूत॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥९॥
19.45.e: May Bhaga with good fortune protect me, etc.

19.45.d: मरु॒तो मा गणै॒र् अवन्तु प्राणा॒यापाना॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे ते॒जसे । स्वस्त॒ये सुभूत॒ये स्वा॒हा ॥१०॥
19.45.e: May the Maruts protect me with their troops for inspiration and expiration, for strength, for energy, for vigour, for weal and prosperity. All Hail!

19.46.d: प्रजा॒पतिष् ट्वा बध्नात् प्रथम॒म् अ॒स्तृतं वीर्या॑य क॒म् । त॒त् ते बध्नाम्य् आ॒युषे व॒र्चस ओ॒जसे च ब॒लाय चा॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥१॥
19.46.e: For manly strength Prajāpati bound thee on first, invincible. This for long life on thee I bind for splendour, strength, and energy. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: ऊर्ध्व॒स् तिष्ठतु र॒क्षन्न् अ॒प्रमादम् अ॒स्तृतेम॒म् मा॒ त्वा दभन् पण॒यो यातुधा॒नाः । इ॒न्द्र इव द॒स्यून् अ॒व धूनुष्व पृतन्यतः॒ स॒र्वां छ॒त्रून् वि॒ षहस्वा॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥२॥
19.46.e: Erect, invincible, be this man's watchful keeper: let not the Panis or the sorcerers harm thee. Shake off thy foes as Indra scattered Dasyus: quell all enemies. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: शतं॒ च न प्रह॒रन्तो निघ्न॒न्तो न॒ तस्तिरे॒ । त॒स्मिन्न् इ॒न्द्रः प॒र्य् अदत्त च॒क्षुः प्राण॒म् अ॒थो ब॒लम् अ॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥३॥
19.46.e: Indra hath lent the power of sight, and vital breath and strength to this. Whom even a hundred combatants, striking, have failed to over- come. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: इ॒न्द्रस्य त्वा व॒र्मणा प॒रि धापयामो यो॒ देवा॒नाम् अधिराजो॒ बभू॒व । पु॒नस् त्वा देवाः॒ प्र॒ णयन्तु स॒र्वे॒ ऽस्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥४॥
19.46.e: Around thy limbs I place the mail of Indra who hath become the Gods' imperial Sovran. Again let all the Deities bring thee hither. Invincible let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: अस्मि॒न् मणा॒व् ए॒कशतं वीर्या॑णि सह॒स्रं प्राणा॒ अस्मिन्न् अ॒स्तृते । व्याघ्रः॒ श॒त्रून् अभि॒ तिष्ठ स॒र्वान् य॒स् त्वा पृतन्याद् अ॒धरः सो॒ अस्त्व् अ॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥५॥
19.46.e: One and a hundred manly powers, a thousand lives hath this Amulet, unconquered ever. Go forth a tiger, strike down all thy foemen: let him who would oppose fall low beneath thee. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: घृता॒द् उ॒ल्लुप्तो म॒धुमान् प॒यस्वान्त् सह॒स्रप्राणः शत॒योनिर् वयोधाः॒ । शम्भू॒श् च मयोभू॒श् चो॒र्जस्वांश् च प॒यस्वांश् चा॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥६॥
19.46.e: Drawn forth from butter, rich in milk and sweetness, hundred- lived, thousand-homed, bestowing vigour, Kindly, delightsome, full of sap, and mighty, invincible let it guard thee well.

19.46.d: य॒था त्व॒म् उत्तरो॒ ऽसो असपत्नः॒ सपत्नहा॒ । सजाता॒नाम् असद् वशी॒ त॒था त्वा सविता॒ करद् अ॒स्तृतस् त्वाभि॒ रक्षतु ॥७॥
19.46.e: That thou mayst be pre-eminent, slayer of rivals, rivalless, May Savitar cause thee to be chief and controller of thy kin. Invincible, let it guard thee well.

19.47.d: आ॒ रात्रि पा॒र्थिवं र॒जः पितु॒र् अप्रायि धा॒मभिः । दिवः॒ स॒दांसि बृहती॒ वि॒ तिष्ठस आ॒ त्वेषं॒ वर्तते त॒मः ॥१॥
19.47.e: Night! the terrestrial realm hath been filled with the Father's power and might. Thou spreadest forth on high unto the seats of Heaven: dark- ness that strikes with awe comes near.

19.47.d: न॒ य॒स्याः पारं॒ द॒दृशे न॒ यो॒युवद् वि॒श्वम् अस्यां॒ नि॒ विशते य॒द् ए॒जति । अ॒रिष्टासस् त उर्वि तमस्वति रा॒त्रि पार॒म् अशीमहि भ॒द्रे पार॒म् अशीमहि ॥२॥
19.47.e: Each moving thing finds rest in her whose yonder boundary is not seen, nor that which keeps her separate. O spacious, darksome Night, may we uninjured reach the end of thee, reach, O thou blessed One, thine end.

19.47.d: ये॒ ते रात्रि नृच॒क्षसो द्रष्टा॒रो नवति॒र् न॒व । अशीतिः॒ स॒न्त्य् अष्टा॒ उतो॒ ते सप्त॒ सप्ततिः॒ ॥३॥
19.47.e: Thy ninety-nine examiners, O Night, who look upon mankind, Eighty-and-eight in number, or seven-and-seventy are they.

19.47.d: षष्टि॒श् च ष॒ट् च रेवति पञ्चाश॒त् प॒ञ्च सुम्नयि । चत्वा॒रश् चत्वारिंश॒च् च त्र॒यस् त्रिंश॒च् च वाजिनि ॥४॥
19.47.e: Sixty-and-six, O opulent, fifty-and-five, O happy One, Forty-and-four and thirty-three are they, O thou enriched with spoil.

19.47.d: द्वौ॒ च ते विंशति॒श् च ते रा॒त्र्य् ए॒कादशावमाः॒ । ते॒भिर् नो अद्य॒ पायु॒भिर् नु॒ पाहि दुहितर् दिवः ॥५॥
19.47.e: Twenty-and-two hast thou, O Night, eleven, yea, and fewer still. With these protectors guard us well. O Daughter of the Sky, to- day.

19.47.d: र॒क्षा मा॒किर् नो अघ॒शंस ईशत मा॒ नो दुःशं॒स ईशत । मा॒ नो अद्य॒ ग॒वां स्तेनो॒ मा॒वीनां वृ॒क ईशत ॥६॥
19.47.e: Let not a fiends or spiteful man, let no ill-wisher master us. Let not the robber seize our cows, nor the wolf take our sheep today.

19.47.d: मा॒श्वानां भद्रे त॒स्करो मा॒ नृणां॒ यातुधान्यः॑ । परमे॒भिः पथि॒भि स्तेनो॒ धावतु त॒स्करः । प॒रेण दत्व॒ती र॒ज्जुः प॒रेणाघायु॒र् अर्षतु ॥७॥
19.47.e: Let not the thief, O Blessed, seize our horses, nor she-fiends our men. Let thief and robber run away on pathways most remote from us.

19.47.d: अ॒ध रात्रि तृष्ट॒धूमम् अशीर्षा॒णम् अ॒हिं कृणु । ह॒नू वृ॒कस्य जम्भ॒या स्तेनं॒ द्रुपदे॒ जहि ॥८॥
19.47.e: Far from us let Rope with Fangs, far from us let the wicked flee. Do thou make blind and headless. Night, the serpent with his pungent breath.

19.47.d: त्व॒यि रात्रि वसामसि स्वपिष्या॒मसि जागृहि॒ । गो॒भ्यो नः श॒र्म यछा॒श्वेभ्यः पु॒रुषेभ्यः ॥९॥
19.47.e: Crush the wolf's jaws in pieces, strike the robber dead against a post. In thee, O Night, do we abide: we here will sleep. Be watchful thou. Give thou protection to our kine; and to our horses, and our men.

19.48.d: अ॒थो या॒नि च य॒स्मा ह या॒नि चान्तः॒ परीण॒हि । ता॒नि ते प॒रि दद्मसि ॥१॥
19.48.e: Then all that we accumulate, all that the treasure-chest contains,. All this do we entrust to thee.

19.48.d: रा॒त्रि मा॒तर् उष॒से नः प॒रि देहि । उषा॒ नो अ॒ह्ने प॒रि ददात्व् अ॒हस् तु॒भ्यं विभावरि ॥२॥
19.48.e: Entrust thou us to Dawn, O Mother Night. May Dawn entrust us to the Day, and Day to thee, O splendid. One.

19.48.d: य॒त् किं॒ चेदं॒ पत॒यति य॒त् किं॒ चेदं॒ सरीसृप॒म् । य॒त् किं॒ च प॒र्वतायास॒त्वं त॒स्मात् त्वं॒ रात्रि पाहि नः ॥३॥
19.48.e: Whatever flying thing be here, whatever thing that creeps and. crawls. Whatever fastens on a joint, therefrom do thou protect us, Night.

19.48.d: सा॒ पश्चा॒त् पाहि सा॒ पुरः॒ सो॒त्तरा॒द् अधरा॒द् उत॒ । गोपाय॒ नो विभावरि स्तोता॒रस् त इह॒ स्मसि ॥४॥
19.48.e: So guard thou us from west and east, protect us from the north and south. O splendid One, preserve us: we, the singers of thy praise, are here.

19.48.d: ये॒ रा॒त्रिम् अनुति॒ष्ठन्ति ये॒ च भूते॒षु जा॒ग्रति । पशू॒न् ये॒ स॒र्वान् र॒क्षन्ति ते॒ न आत्म॒सु जाग्रति ते॒ नः पशु॒षु जाग्रति ॥५॥
19.48.e: They who are followers of Night, and they who watch o'er living things. They who protect all cattle, they keep watch and ward over our lives, over our herds keep watch and ward.

19.48.d: वे॒द वै॒ रात्रि ते ना॒म घृता॒ची ना॒म वा॒ असि । तां॒ त्वां॒ भर॒द्वाजो वेद सा॒ नो वित्ते॒ ऽधि जाग्रति ॥६॥
19.48.e: Verily, Night, I know thy name, Dropper of Fatness art thou called. Thee Bharadvāja knew as such: as such be watchful o'er our wealth.

19.49.d: इषिरा॒ यो॒षा युवति॒र् द॒मूना रा॒त्री देव॒स्य सवितु॒र् भ॒गस्य । अश्वक्षभा॒ सुह॒वा सं॒भृतश्रीर् आ॒ पप्रौ द्या॒वापृथिवी॒ महित्वा॒ ॥१॥
19.49.e: Friend of the home, the strong and youthful maiden, Night, dear to Savitar the God, and Bhaga, All-compassing, all-glorious, prompt to listen, hath with her greatness filled the earth and heaven.

19.49.d: अ॒ति वि॒श्वान्य् अरुहद् गम्भिरो॒ व॒र्षिष्ठम् अरुहन्त श्र॒विष्ठाः । उशती॒ रा॒त्र्य् अ॒नु सा॒ भद्राभि॒ तिष्ठते मित्र॒ इव स्वधा॒भिः ॥२॥
19.49.e: Over all depths hath she gone up, and mounted, most mighty One, the sky's exalted summit. Over me now the loving Night is spreading with her auspicious. Godlike ways like Mitra.

19.49.d: व॒र्ये व॒न्दे सु॒भगे सु॒जात आ॒जगन् रा॒त्रि सुम॒ना इह॒ स्याम् । अस्मां॒स् त्रायस्व न॒र्याणि जाता॒ अ॒थो या॒नि ग॒व्यानि पुष्ट्या॒ ॥३॥
19.49.e: Excellent, high-born, blissful, meet for worship, Night, thou hast come: stay here with friendly spirit. Guard us, the food for men that we have gotten, and all pro- sperity that comes of cattle.

19.49.d: सिंह॒स्य रा॒त्र्य् उशती॒ पींष॒स्य व्याघ्र॒स्य द्वीपि॒नो व॒र्च आ॒ ददे । अ॒श्वस्य ब्रध्नं॒ पु॒रुषस्य मायुं॒ पुरु॒ रूपा॒णि कृणुषे विभाती॒ ॥४॥
19.49.e: With eager haste hath Night assumed the vigour of leopard,. tiger, or of tawny lion, The horse's neighing and the wild-man's bellow, Thou takest many a form when thou appearest.

19.49.d: शिवां॒ रा॒त्रिम् अनुसू॒र्यं च हिम॒स्य माता॒ सुह॒वा नो अस्तु । अस्य॒ स्तो॒मस्य सुभगे नि॒ बोध ये॒न त्वा व॒न्दे वि॒श्वासु दिक्षु॒ ॥५॥
19.49.e: Kind through the Night be absence of the sunshine: Mother of Frost, may she be swift to hear us. Take notice of the hymn, thou highly favoured, wherewith I worship thee in all the regions.

19.49.d: स्तो॒मस्य नो विभावरि रा॒त्रि रा॒जेव जोषसे । अ॒साम स॒र्ववीरा भ॒वाम स॒र्ववेदसो व्युछ॒न्तीर् अ॒नूष॒सः ॥६॥
19.49.e: Even as a King, O splendid Night, thou takest pleasure in our hymn. May we through Mornings as they flush have all our good men, round us, and become possessors of all wealth.

19.49.d: श॒म्या ह ना॒म दधिषे॒ म॒म दि॒प्सन्ति ये॒ ध॒ना । रा॒त्रीहि॒ ता॒न् असुतपा॒ य॒ स्तेनो॒ न॒ विद्य॒ते य॒त् पु॒नर् न॒ विद्य॒ते ॥७॥
19.49.e: Yes, Rāmyā is the name thou hast assumed. The men who fain. would spoil. My wealth do thou annoy, O Night, that not one robber may appear, none may a second time appear.

19.49.d: भद्रा॒सि रात्रि चमसो॒ न॒ विष्टो॒ वि॒ष्वङ् गो॒रूपं युवति॒र् बिभर्षि । च॒क्षुष्मती मे उशती॒ व॒पूम्षि प्र॒ति त्वं॒ दिव्या॒ न॒ क्षाम् अमुक्थाः ॥८॥
19.49.e: Thou like a well-wrought cup, O Night, art lovely: thou, a. young maid, art formed in perfect beauty. Thou lovingly, for me with eyes to se: them, hast bound on thee heaven's stars as thine adornment.

19.49.d: यो॒ अद्य॒ स्तेन॒ आ॒यत्य् अघायु॒र् म॒र्त्यो रिपुः॒ । रा॒त्री त॒स्य प्रती॒त्य प्र॒ ग्रीवाः॒ प्र॒ शि॒रो हनत् ॥९॥
19.49.e: Whatever robber comes to-day, mischievous mortal enemy. Let Night go forth, encounter him, and smite away his neck and head;

19.49.d: प्र॒ पादौ न॒ य॒था॒यति प्र॒ ह॒स्तौ न॒ य॒था॒शिषत् । यो॒ मलिम्लु॒र् उपा॒यति स॒ सं॒पिष्टो अ॒पायति । अ॒पायति स्व॒पायति शु॒ष्के स्थाणा॒व् अ॒पायति ॥१०॥
19.49.e: His feet that he may walk no more, his hands that he may do no harm. The robber who comes hitherward goes crushed and mutilated hence, Goes hence, goes far away from us, goes hence and bears no spoil away.

19.50.d: अ॒ध रात्रि तृष्ट॒धूमम् अशीर्षा॒णम् अ॒हिं कृणु । अक्षौ॒ वृ॒कस्य नि॒र् जह्यास् ते॒न तं॒ द्रुपदे॒ जहि ॥१॥
19.50.e: Blind him and make him headless, Night! the serpent with the pungent breath. Strike from his head the wolf's two eyes, and dash the thief against a post.

19.50.d: ये॒ ते रात्र्य् अनड्वा॒हस् तीक्ष्ण॒शृङ्गाः स्वाश॒वः । ते॒भिर् नो अद्य॒ पारया॒ति दुर्गा॒णि विश्व॒हा ॥२॥
19.50.e: Those oxen that are thine, O Night, with sharpened horns and rapid pace, With those transport us safe to-day o'er difficulties everywhere.

19.50.d: रा॒त्रिंरात्रिम् अ॒रिष्यन्तस् त॒रेम तन्वा॑ वय॒म् । गम्भीर॒म् अ॒प्लवा इव न॒ तरेयुर् अ॒रातयः ॥३॥
19.50.e: Uninjured in our bodies may we pass through each succeeding night, And let malignities fail to pass, as men without a boat the depth.

19.50.d: य॒था शाम्या॒कः प्रप॒तन्न् अपवा॒न् ना॒नुविद्य॒ते । एवा॒ रात्रि प्र॒ पातय यो॒ अस्मां॒ अभ्यघाय॒ति ॥४॥
19.50.e: As millet hurried through the air before us is beheld no more. So cause the man to vanish, Night, who plans to do us injury.

19.50.d: अ॒प स्तेनं॒ वा॒सयो गोअज॒म् उत॒ त॒स्करम् । अ॒थो यो॒ अ॒र्वतः शि॒रो ऽभिधा॒य नि॒नीषति ॥५॥
19.50.e: The thief hast thou kept far away, the robber driver of our kine. Even him who having covered up the horse's head would lead him off.

19.50.d: य॒द् अद्य॒ रात्रि सुभगे विभ॒जन्त्य् अ॒यो व॒सु । य॒द् एत॒द् अस्मा॒न् भो॒जय य॒थे॒द् अन्या॒न् उपा॒यसि ॥६॥
19.50.e: If dealing treasure thou hast come to-day, O highly favoured Night. Cause thou us to enjoy it all so that this may not pass away.

19.50.d: उष॒से नः प॒रि देहि स॒र्वान् रात्र्य् अनाग॒सः । उषा॒ नो अ॒ह्ने आ॒ भजाद् अ॒हस् तु॒भ्यं विभावरि ॥७॥
19.50.e: Do thou entrust us to the Dawn, all of us free from sin, O Night. May Dawn deliver us to Day, and Day to thee, O glorious One.

19.51.d: अ॒युतो ऽह॒म् अ॒युतो म आत्मा॒युतं मे च॒क्षुर् अ॒युतं मे श्रो॒त्रम् । अ॒युतो मे प्राणो॒ ऽयुतो मे ऽपानो॒ ऽयुतो मे व्यानो॒ ऽयुतो ऽहं॒ स॒र्वः ॥१॥
19.51.e: Undisturbed am I, undisturbed is my soul, undisturbed mine eye, undisturbed mine ear, undisturbed is mine in-breathing, undisturbed mine out-breathing, undisturbed my diffusive- breath, undisturbed the whole of me.

19.51.d: देव॒स्य त्वा सवितुः॒ प्रसवे॒ ऽश्वि॒नोर् बाहु॒भ्यां पूष्णो॒ ह॒स्ताभ्यां प्र॒सूत आ॒ रभे ॥२॥
19.51.e: Under the impulse of the God Savitar, sent forth from the arms- of the Asvins and both hands of Pūshan I have taken thee.

19.52.d: का॒मस् त॒द् अ॒ग्रे स॒म् अवर्तत म॒नसो रे॒तः प्रथमं॒ य॒द् आ॒सीत् । स॒ काम का॒मेन बृहता॒ स॒योनी राय॒स् पो॒षं य॒जमानाय धेहि ॥१॥
19.52.e: Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire the primal seed and germ of Spirit. O Kāma dwelling with the lofty Kāma, give growth of riches to the sacrificer.

19.52.d: त्वं॒ काम स॒हसासि प्र॒तिष्ठितो विभु॒र् विभा॒वा सख आ॒ सखीयते॒ । त्व॒म् उग्रः॒ पृ॒तनासु ससहिः॒ स॒ह ओ॒जो य॒जमानाय धेहि ॥२॥
19.52.e: Thou, Kāma, art victorious, famous, potent, splendid, a friend. to him who seeks thy friendship. Mighty and overpowering in battle, give strength and vigour to the sacrificer.

19.52.d: दूरा॒च् चकमाना॒य प्रतिपाणा॒या॒क्षये । आ॒स्मा अशृण्वन्न् आ॒शाः का॒मेनाजनयन्त् स्वः॑ ॥३॥
19.52.e: They heard his prayers, and they begot, by Kāma, heavenly- light for him. Who from a distance longed for it, a dealer ready to exchange.

19.52.d: का॒मेन मा का॒म आ॒गन् हृ॒दयाद् धृ॒दयं प॒रि । य॒द् अमी॒षाम् अदो॒ म॒नस् त॒द् ऐ॒तू॒प माम् इह॒ ॥४॥
19.52.e: O Kāma, with whatever wish we make this offering to thee, May it be all fulfilled to us. Then taste this sacrifice, All hail!

19.52.d: य॒त् काम काम॒यमाना इदं॒ कृण्म॒सि ते हविः॒ । त॒न् नः स॒र्वं स॒म् ऋध्यताम् अ॒थैत॒स्य हवि॒षो वीहि स्वा॒हा ॥५॥

19.53.d: कालो॒ अ॒श्वो वहति सप्त॒रश्मिः सहस्राक्षो॒ अज॒रो भू॒रिरेताः । त॒म् आ॒ रोहन्ति कव॒यो विपश्चि॒तस् त॒स्य चक्रा॒ भु॒वनानि वि॒श्वा ॥१॥
19.53.e: Prolific, thousand-eyed, and undecaying, a horse with seven reins Time bears us onward. Sages inspired with holy knowledge mount him: his chariot wheels are all the worlds of creatures.

19.53.d: सप्त॒ चक्रा॒न् वहति काल॒ एष॒ सप्ता॒स्य ना॒भीर् अमृ॒तं न्व् अ॒क्षः । स॒ इमा॒ वि॒श्वा भु॒वनान्य् अञ्जत् कालः॒ स॒ ईयते प्रथमो॒ नु॒ देवः॒ ॥२॥
19.53.e: This Time hath seven rolling wheels and seven naves immorality is the chariot's axle. This Time brings hitherward all worlds about us: as primal Deity is he entreated.

19.53.d: पूर्णः॒ कुम्भो॒ ऽधि काल॒ आ॒हितस् तं॒ वै॒ प॒श्यामो बहुधा॒ नु॒ स॒न्तम् । स॒ इमा॒ वि॒श्वा भु॒वनानि प्रत्य॒ङ् कालं॒ त॒म् आहुः॒ परमे॒ व्यो॑मन् ॥३॥
19.53.e: On Time is laid an overflowing beaker: this we behold in many a place appearing. He carries from us all these worlds of creatures. They call him Kāla in the loftiest heaven.

19.53.d: स॒ एव॒ सं॒ भु॒वनान्य् आ॒भरत् स॒ एव॒ सं॒ भु॒वनानि प॒र्य् ऐत् । पिता॒ स॒न्न् अभवत् पुत्र॒ एषां त॒स्माद् वै॒ ना॒न्य॒त् प॒रम् अस्ति ते॒जः ॥४॥
19.53.e: He only made the worlds of life, he only gathered the worlds of living things together. Their son did he become who was their Father: no other higher power than he existeth.

19.53.d: कालो॒ ऽमूं॒ दि॒वम् अजनयत् काल॒ इमाः॒ पृथिवी॒र् उत॒ । काले॒ ह भूतं॒ भ॒व्यं चेषितं॒ ह वि॒ तिष्ठते ॥५॥
19.53.e: Kāla created yonder heaven, and Kāla made these realms of earth. By Kāla, stirred to motion, both what is and what shall be expand.

19.53.d: कालो॒ भूति॒म् असृजत काले॒ त॒पति सू॒र्यः । काले॒ ह वि॒श्वा भूता॒नि काले॒ च॒क्षुर् वि॒ पश्यति ॥६॥
19.53.e: Kāla created land; the Sun in Kāla hath his light and heat. In Kāla rest all things that be: in Kāla doth the eye discern.

19.53.d: काले॒ म॒नः काले॒ प्राणः॒ काले॒ ना॒म समा॒हितम् । काले॒न स॒र्वा नन्दन्त्य् आ॒गतेन प्रजा॒ इमाः॒ ॥७॥
19.53.e: In Kāla mind, in Kāla breath, in Kāla name are fixt and joined. These living creatures, one and all, rejoice when Kāla hath approached.

19.53.d: काले॒ त॒पः काले॒ ज्ये॒ष्ठम् काले॒ ब्र॒ह्म समा॒हितम् । कालो॒ ह स॒र्वस्येश्वरो॒ यः॒ पिता॒सीत् प्रजा॒पतेः ॥८॥
19.53.e: Kāla embraces Holy Fire, the Highest, Brahma in himself. Yea, Kāla, who was father of Prajāpati, is Lord of All.

19.53.d: ते॒नेषितं॒ ते॒न जातं॒ त॒द् उ त॒स्मिन् प्र॒तिष्ठितम् । कालो॒ ह ब्र॒ह्म भूत्वा॒ बि॒भर्ति परमेष्ठि॒नम् ॥९॥
19.53.e: He made, he stirred this universe to motion, and on him it rests. He, Kāla, having now become Brahma, holds Parameshthin up.

19.53.d: कालः॒ प्रजा॒ असृजत कालो॒ अ॒ग्रे प्रजा॒पतिम् । स्वयंभूः॒ कश्य॒पः काला॒त् त॒पः काला॒द् अजायत ॥१०॥
19.53.e: Kāla created living things and, first of all, Prajāpati. From Kāla self-made Kasyapa, from Kāla Holy Fire was born.

19.54.d: काला॒द् आ॒पः स॒म् अभवन् काला॒द् ब्र॒ह्म त॒पो दि॒शः । काले॒नो॒द् एति सू॒र्यः काले॒ नि॒ विशते पु॒नः ॥१॥
19.54.e: From Kāla sprang the Waters, sprang the regions, Brahma, Holy Fire. The Sun ascends by Kāla, and in Kāla sinks again to rest.

19.54.d: काले॒न वा॒तः पवते काले॒न पृथिवी॒ मही॒ । द्यौ॒र् मही॒ काल॒ आ॒हिता ॥२॥
19.54.e: By Kāla freshly blows the wind, mighty through Kāla is the Earth: on Kāla rests the mighty Sky.

19.54.d: कालो॒ ह भूतं॒ भ॒व्यं च पुत्रो॒ अजनयत् पुरा॒ । काला॒द् ऋ॒चः स॒म् अभवन् य॒जुः काला॒द् अजायत ॥३॥
19.54.e: In Kāla erst the text produced what is and what is yet to be. From Kāla sprang the Richas, and from Kāla was the Yajus born.

19.54.d: कालो॒ यज्ञं॒ स॒म् ऐरयद् देवे॒भ्यो भाग॒म् अ॒क्षितम् । काले॒ गन्धर्वाप्सर॒सः काले॒ लोकाः॒ प्र॒तिष्ठिताः ॥४॥
19.54.e: They formed in Kāla sacrifice, eternal portion for the Gods. In Kāla the Gandharvas and Apsarasas and worlds abide.

19.54.d: काले॒ ऽय॒म् अ॒ङ्गिरा देवो॒ ऽथर्वा चा॒धि तिष्ठतः । इमं॒ च लोकं॒ परमं॒ च लोकं॒ पु॒ण्यांश् च लोका॒न् वि॒धृतीश् च पु॒ण्याः । स॒र्वांल् लोका॒न् अभिजि॒त्य ब्र॒ह्मणा कालः॒ स॒ ईयते परमो॒ नु॒ देवः॒ ॥५॥
19.54.e: Atharvan and this Angiras in Kāla are supreme o'er heaven. Both this world and the world that is most lofty, the pure worlds and pure intermediate spaces,— Yea, having conquered all the worlds by Brahma, Kāla as God Supreme is supplicated.

19.55.d: रा॒त्रिंरात्रिम् अ॒प्रयातं भ॒रन्तो॒ ऽश्वायेव ति॒ष्ठते घास॒म् अस्मै॒ । राय॒स् पो॒षेण स॒म् इषा॒ म॒दन्तो मा॒ ते अग्ने प्र॒तिवेशा रिषाम ॥१॥
19.55.e: Bringing, as 'twere, with care unceasing fodder night after night to feed this stabled Courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neigh- bours, Agni, ne'er be injured.

19.55.d: या॒ ते व॒सोर् वा॒त इ॒षुः सा॒ त एषा॒ त॒या नो मृड । राय॒स् पो॒षेण स॒म् इषा॒ म॒दन्तो मा॒ ते अग्ने प्र॒तिवेशा रिषाम ॥२॥
19.55.e: Here is thine own desire for wealth: through this be gracious unto us. Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neigh- bours, Agni, ne'er be injured.

19.55.d: सायं॒सायं गृह॒पतिर् नो अग्निः॒ प्रातः॒प्रातः सौमनस॒स्य दाता॒ । व॒सोर्वसोर् वसुदा॒न एधि वयं॒ त्वे॒न्धानास् तन्वं॑ पुषेम ॥३॥
19.55.e: Each eve that comes our household's Lord is Agni, showing his. loving-kindness every morning. Bestow upon us treasure after treasure: enkindling thee may we increase thy body.

19.55.d: प्रातः॒प्रातर् गृह॒पतिर् नो अग्निः॒ सायं॒सायं सौमनस॒स्य दाता॒ । व॒सोर्वसोर् वसुदा॒न एधी॒न्धानास् त्वा शतं॒हिमा ऋधेम ॥४॥
19.55.e: Each morn that comes our household's Lord is Agni, showing. his loving-kindness every evening. Vouchsafe us treasure after treasure: kindling thee may we prosper through a hundred winters.

19.55.d: अ॒पश्चा दग्धा॒न्नस्य भूयासम् । अन्नादा॒यान्नपतये रुद्रा॒य न॒मो अग्न॒ये । सभ्यः॒ सभां॒ मे पाहि ये॒ च सभ्याः॒ सभास॒दः ॥५॥
19.55.e: Never may I come short of food to feed me. Glory to Agni, Rudra, the consumer and the Lord of food!

19.55.d: त्वाम् इन्द्रा पुरुहूत वि॒श्वम् आ॒युर् व्य् अ॑श्नवन् । अ॒हरहर् बलि॒म् इ॒त् ते ह॒रन्तो॒ ऽश्वायेव ति॒ष्ठते घास॒म् अग्ने ॥६॥
19.55.e: Protect my company, protect its courteous members, courteous. God! Only through thee, O much-invoked, may I be ever rich in kine. Only to thee bringing our tribute, Agni, each day as fodder to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we the neigh- bours, Agni ne'er be injured.

19.56.d: यम॒स्य लोका॒द् अ॒ध्य् आ॒ बभूविथ प्र॒मदा म॒र्त्यान् प्र॒ युनक्षि धी॒रः । एकाकि॒ना सर॒थं यासि विद्वा॒न्त् स्व॒प्नं मि॒मानो अ॒सुरस्य यो॒नौ ॥१॥
19.56.e: Thou art come hither from the world of Yama: thou, resolute, affectest men with rapture. Thou, Sleep, created in the Asura's dwelling, goest, well-know- ing, with the solitary.

19.56.d: बन्ध॒स् त्वा॒ग्रे विश्व॒चया अपश्यत् पुरा॒ रा॒त्र्या ज॒नितोर् ए॒के अ॒ह्नि । त॒तः स्वप्नेद॒म् अ॒ध्य् आ॒ बभूविथ भिष॒ग्भ्यो रूप॒म् अपगू॒हमानः ॥२॥
19.56.e: At first the all-containing, depth beheld thee, ere Night was born, when only Day existed. Thence hast thou come, thence, Sleep, hast thou come hither, concealing, deep within, all form and figure.

19.56.d: बृहद्गा॒वा॒सुरेभ्यो॒ ऽधि देवा॒न् उ॒पावर्तत महिमा॒नम् इछ॒न् । त॒स्मै स्व॒प्नाय दधुर् आ॒धिपत्यं त्रयस्त्रिंशा॒सः स्व॑र् आनशानाः॒ ॥३॥
19.56.e: Come from the Asuras in lofty, glory, he hath approached the Gods in search of greatness. Winners of heavenly light, the Three-and-Thirty endowed this Sleep with his supreme dominion.

19.56.d: नै॒तां॒ विदुः पित॒रो नो॒त॒ देवा॒ ये॒षां ज॒ल्पिश् च॒रत्य् अन्तरे॒द॒म् । त्रिते॒ स्व॒प्नम् अदधुर् आप्त्ये॒ न॒र आदित्या॒सो व॒रुणेना॒नुशिष्टाः ॥४॥
19.56.e: Of him nor Fathers nor the Gods have knowledge, the Gods whose gentle talk is still about him. Urged by command of Varuna the Ādityas, Heroes, transported Sleep to Trita Āptya.

19.56.d: य॒स्य क्रूर॒म् अ॒भजन्त दुष्कृ॒तो ऽस्व॒प्नेन सुकृ॒तः पु॒ण्यम् आ॒युः । स्व॑र् मदसि परमे॒ण बन्धु॒ना तप्य॒मानस्य म॒नसो॒ ऽधि जज्ञिषे ॥५॥
19.56.e: Thou whose severity hath reached ill-doers, and whose reward the good have gained in slumber, Delightest heaven with thy most lofty kinship, born from his spirit who was worn and weary.

19.56.d: विद्म॒ ते स॒र्वाः परिजाः॒ पुर॒स्ताद् विद्म॒ स्वप्न यो॒ अधिपा॒ इहा॒ ते । यशश्वि॒नो नो य॒शसेह॒ पाह्य् आरा॒द् द्विषे॒भिर् अ॒प याहि दूर॒म् ॥६॥
19.56.e: Of old we know all places whence thou comest. O Sleep, we know him who is here thy ruler. Protect us here illustrious with glory. Go, from afar, with poisons, into distance.

19.57.d: य॒था कलां॒ य॒था शफं॒ य॒था र्णं॒ सम्न॒यन्ति । एवा॒ दुष्व॒प्न्यं स॒र्वम् अ॒प्रिये सं॒ नयामसि ॥१॥
19.57.e: As men discharge the utmost debt, collect the eighth and sixteenth part, So to the foeman we transfer together all the evil dream.

19.57.d: सं॒ रा॒जानो अगुः स॒म् ऋणा॒म्य् अगुः सं॒ कुष्ठा॒ अगुः सं॒ कला॒ अगुः । स॒म् अस्मा॒सु य॒द् दुष्व॒प्न्यं नि॒र् द्विषते॒ दुष्व॒प्न्यं सुवाम ॥२॥
19.57.e: Princes came together, debts came together, Kushthas came to- gether, Sixteenths came together. The whole evil dream that hath visited us we send away as a bad dream to the man who hates us.

19.57.d: दे॒वानां पत्नीनां गर्भ य॒मस्य कर यो॒ भद्रः॒ स्वप्न । स॒ म॒म यः॒ पाप॒स् त॒द् द्विषते॒ प्र॒ हिण्मः । मा॒ तृष्टा॒नाम् असि कृष्णशकुने॒र् मु॒खम् ॥३॥
19.57.e: Child of Gods' Consorts, minister of Yama is the good Dream: that which is my trouble we drive away to the enemy.

19.57.d: तं॒ त्वा स्वप्न त॒था सं॒ विद्म स॒ त्वं॒ स्वप्ना॒श्व इव काय॒म् अ॒श्व इव नीनाह॒म् । अनास्माकं॒ देवपीयुं॒ पि॒यारुं वप य॒द् अस्मा॒सु दुष्व॒प्न्यं य॒द् गो॒षु य॒च् च नो गृहे॒ ॥४॥
19.57.e: Thou whose name is Rough art the mouth of the Black Bird. As such we know thee, Dream, as such we know thee well. Like a horse art thou, O Dream. As they bind girth and surcingle on a horse, so bind the alien mischief-maker, the scorner of the Gods.

19.57.d: अनास्माक॒स् त॒द् देवपीयुः॒ पि॒यारुर् निष्क॒म् इव प्र॒ति मुञ्चताम् । न॒वारत्नी॒न् अ॒पमया अस्मा॒कं त॒तः प॒रि । दुष्व॒प्न्यं स॒र्वं द्विषते॒ नि॒र् दयामसि ॥५॥
19.57.e: The evil dream that threatens us, threatens our cattle or our home. That let the scorner of the Gods, the alien mischief-maker bind as a gold jewel round his neck. Having measured off nine cubits' distance from us we give away the whole of the evil dream to the man who hates us.

19.58.d: घृत॒स्य जूतिः॒ स॒मना स॒देवा संवत्सरं॒ हवि॒षा वर्ध॒यन्ती । श्रो॒त्रं च॒क्षुः प्राणो॒ ऽछिन्नो नो अस्त्व् अ॒छिन्ना वय॒म् आ॒युषो व॒र्चसः ॥१॥
19.58.e: Still equal be the flow of butter ever causing the Year to prosper with oblation. Still be our hearing, sight, and breath uninjured: let us lose nothing of our life and vigour.

19.58.d: उ॒पास्मा॒न् प्राणो॒ ह्वयताम् उ॒प प्राणं॒ हवामहे । व॒र्चो जग्राह पृथिव्य् अ॑न्त॒रिक्षं व॒र्चः सो॒मो बृ॒हस्प॒तिर् विधत्ता॒ ॥२॥
19.58.e: Let lively breath invite us: we call vital breath to visit us. Earth and air's middle realm have gathered, Soma, Brihaspati and Dhartar gathered vigour.

19.58.d: व॒र्चसो द्यावापृथिवी॒ संग्र॒हणी बभूव॒थुर् व॒र्चो गृहीत्वा पृथिवी॒म् अ॒नु सं॒ चरेम । यश॒सम् गा॒वो गो॒पतिम् उ॒प तिष्ठन्त्य् आयती॒र् य॒शो गृहीत्वा॒ पृथिवी॒म् अ॒नु सं॒ चरेम ॥३॥
19.58.e: The earth and heaven have come to be two gatherers up of vigo- rous might. So let us gather vigour up and closely follow after Earth. With glory come the cows and stand beside the master of the herd. Let us when we have gathered fame and glory closely follow Earth.

19.58.d: व्रजं॒ कृणुध्वं स॒ हि॒ वो नृपा॒णो व॒र्मा सीव्यध्वं बहुला॒ पृथू॒नि । पु॒रः कृणुध्वम् आ॒यसीर् अ॒धृष्टा मा॒ वः सुस्रोच् चमसो॒ दृंहत त॒म् ॥४॥
19.58.e: Prepare the cow-stall, for there drink your heroes: stitch ye the coats of armour wide and many. Make iron forts defying all assailants: let not your pitcher leak; stay it securely.

19.58.d: यज्ञ॒स्य च॒क्षुः प्र॒भृतिर् मु॒खं च वाचा॒ श्रो॒त्रेण म॒नसा जुहोमि । इमं॒ यज्ञं॒ वि॒ततं विश्व॒कर्मणा॒ देवा॒ यन्तु सुमनस्य॒मानाः ॥५॥
19.58.e: The eye of sacrifice, source and beginning with voice, car, spirit unto him I offer. To this our sacrifice, wrought by Visvakarman, may the Gods come gracious and kindly-hearted.

19.58.d: ये॒ देवा॒नाम् ऋत्वि॒जो ये॒ च यज्ञि॒या ये॒भ्यो हव्यं॒ क्रिय॒ते भागधे॒यम् । इमं॒ यज्ञं॒ सह॒ प॒त्नीभिर् ए॒त्य या॒वन्तो देवा॒स् तविषा॒ मादयन्ताम् ॥६॥
19.58.e: Let the Gods' Priests and those who merit worship, to whom oblation as their share is offered, Come to this holy service with their Consorts, and all Gods revel in the food we bring them.

19.59.d: त्व॒म् अग्ने व्रतपा॒ असि देव॒ आ॒ म॒र्त्येष्व् आ॒ । त्वं॒ यज्ञे॒ष्व् ई॒ड्यः ॥१॥
19.59.e: God among mortals, Agni, thou art guard of holy Law, thou art To be adored in sacred rites.

19.59.d: य॒द् वो वयं॒ प्रमिना॒म व्रता॒नि विदु॒षां देवा अ॒विदुष्टरासः । अग्नि॒ष् ट॒द् विश्वा॒द् आ॒ पृणातु विद्वा॒न्त् सो॒मस्य यो॒ ब्राह्मणां॒ आविवे॒श ॥२॥
19.59.e: When, ignorant, we violate the statutes of you, O Deities, with whom is knowledge, Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, and Soma who hath entered into Brāhmans.

19.59.d: आ॒ देवा॒नाम् अ॒पि प॒न्थाम् अगन्म य॒च् छक्न॒वाम त॒द् अनुप्र॒वोढुम् । अग्नि॒र् विद्वा॒न्त् स॒ यजात् स॒ इ॒द् धो॒ता सो॒ ऽध्वरा॒न्त् स॒ ऋतू॒न् कल्पयाति ॥३॥
19.59.e: To the Gods' pathway have we come desiring to execute what work we may accomplish. Let Agni—for he knows—complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.

19.60.d: वा॒ङ् म आस॒न् नसोः॒ प्राण॒श् च॒क्षुर् अक्ष्णोः॒ श्रो॒त्रं क॒र्णयोः । अ॒पलिताः के॒शा अ॒शोणा द॒न्ता बहु॒ बाह्वो॒र् ब॒लम् ॥१॥
19.60.e: May I have voice in my mouth, breath in my nostrils, sight in mine eyes, hearing in mine ears, hair that hath not turned gray, teeth free from yellowness, and much strength in mine arms.

19.60.d: ऊर्वो॒र् ओ॒जो ज॒ङ्घयोर् जवः॒ पा॒दयोः । प्रतिष्ठा॒ अ॒रिष्टानि मे स॒र्वात्मा॒निभृष्टः ॥२॥
19.60.e: May I have power in my thighs, swiftness in my legs, stedfast- ness in my feet. May all my members be uninjured and my soul unimpaired.

19.61.d: तनू॒स् तन्वा॑ मे सहे दतः॒ स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् अशीय । स्योनं॒ मे सीद पुरुः॒ पृणस्व प॒वमानः स्वर्गे॒ ॥१॥
19.61.e: May my self remain in my body: may I enjoy the full time of life, Rest thee pleasantly: pour forth abundance, purifying thyself in Svarga.

19.62.d: प्रियं॒ मा कृणु देवे॒षु प्रियं॒ रा॒जसु मा कृणु । प्रियं॒ स॒र्वस्य प॒श्यत उत॒ शूद्र॒ उता॒र्ये ॥१॥
19.62.e: Make me beloved among the Gods, beloved among the Princes, make Me dear to everyone who sees, to Sūdra and to Aryan man.

19.63.d: उ॒त् तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस् पते देवा॒न् यज्ञे॒न बोधय । आ॒युः प्राणं॒ प्रजां॒ पशू॒न् कीर्तिं॒ य॒जमानं च वर्धय ॥१॥
19.63.e: Rise up, O Brāhmanaspati; awake the Gods with sacrifice. Strengthen the Sacrificer: aid life, breath, and off-spring, cattle, fame.

19.64.d: अ॒ग्ने समि॒धम् आ॒हार्षं बृहते॒ जात॒वेदसे । स॒ मे श्रद्धां॒ च मेधां॒ च जात॒वेदाः प्र॒ यछतु ॥१॥
19.64.e: For lofty Jātavedas I have brought the fuel hither first. May he who knoweth all bestow faith and intelligence on me.

19.64.d: इध्मे॒न त्वा जातवेदः समि॒धा वर्धयामसि । त॒था त्व॒म् अस्मा॒न् वर्धय प्रज॒या च ध॒नेन च ॥२॥
19.64.e: With fuel and with flaming wood we, Jātavedas, strengthen thee; So do thou strengthen us in turn with children and with store of wealth.

19.64.d: य॒द् अग्ने या॒नि का॒नि चिद् आ॒ ते दा॒रूणि दध्म॒सि । स॒र्वं त॒द् अस्तु मे शिवं॒ त॒ज् जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥३॥
19.64.e: Whatever even be the logs which, Agni, we lay down for thee, propitious be it all to me: accept it, O most youthful God.

19.64.d: एता॒स् ते अग्ने समि॒धस् त्व॒म् इद्धः॒ समि॒द् भव । आ॒युर् अस्मा॒सु धेह्य् अमृतत्व॒म् आचार्या॑य ॥४॥
19.64.e: Agni, these logs are thine: with these be, fain to burn! a flaming brand. Vouchsafe us length of life and give us hope of immortality.

19.65.d: ह॒रिः सुपर्णो॒ दि॒वम् आ॒रुहो ऽर्चि॒षा ये॒ त्वा दि॒प्सन्ति दि॒वम् उत्प॒तन्तम् । अ॒व तां॒ जहि ह॒रसा जातवेदो॒ ऽबिभ्यद् उग्रो॒ ऽर्चि॒षा दि॒वम् आ॒ रोह सूर्य ॥१॥
19.65.e: A Golden Eagle thou hast soared with light to heaven. Those who would harm thee as thou fliest skyward. Beat down, O Jātavedas, with thy fury. The strong hath feared: to heaven mount up with light, O Sūrya.

19.66.d: अ॒योजाला अ॒सुरा मायि॒नो ऽयस्म॒यैः पा॒शैर् अङ्कि॒नो ये॒ च॒रन्ति । तां॒स् ते रन्धयामि ह॒रसा जातवेदः सह॒स्रऋष्टिः सप॒त्नान् प्रमृण॒न् पाहि व॒ज्रः ॥१॥
19.66.e: The Asuras with iron nets, magicians, who roam about with hooks and bonds of iron, With wrath I make thy thralls, O Jātavedas. Come as a bolt foe- quelling, thousand pointed.

19.67.e: A hundred autumns may we see.
A hundred autumns may we live.
A hundred autumns may we know.
A hundred autumns may we grow.
A hundred autumns may we thrive.
A hundred autumns may we be.
A hundred autumns may we bide.
A hundred, yea, and even more.

19.68.d: अ॒व्यसश् च व्य॒चसश् च बि॒लं वि॒ ष्यामि माय॒या । ता॒भ्याम् उद्धृ॒त्य वे॒दम् अ॒थ क॒र्माणि कृण्महे ॥१॥
19.68.e: Both of broad and narrow I with magic power unclose the mouth. With these when we have raised the bunch of grass we pay the holy rites.

19.69.d: जीवा॒ स्थ जीव्या॒सं स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् जीव्यासम् ॥१॥
19.69.e: Ye are alive. I fain would live. I fain would live my complete term of life.

19.69.d: उपजीवा॒ स्थो॒प जीव्यासं स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् जीव्यासम् ॥२॥
19.69.e: Ye live dependent. I fain would live dependent. I fain would live my complete term of life.

19.69.d: संजीवा॒ स्थ सं॒ जीव्यासं स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् जीव्यासम् ॥३॥
19.69.e: Ye remain alive. I fain would remain alive. I fain would live my complete term of life.

19.69.d: जीवला॒ स्थ जीव्या॒सं स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् जीव्यासम् ॥४॥
19.69.e: Ye are life-givers. I fain would live. I fain would live my com- plete term of life.

19.70.d: इ॒न्द्र जी॒व सू॒र्य जी॒व दे॒वा जी॒वा जीव्या॒सम् अह॒म् । स॒र्वम् आ॒युर् जीव्यासम् ॥१॥
19.70.e: Live, Indra. Live Sūrya. Live, ye Gods. I fain would live. Fain would I live my complete term of life.

19.71.d: स्तुता॒ म॒या वरदा॒ वेदमाता॒ प्र॒ चोदयन्तां पावमानी॒ द्विजा॒नाम् । आ॒युः प्राणं॒ प्रजां॒ पशुं॒ कीर्तिं॒ द्र॒विणं ब्रह्मवर्चस॒म् । म॒ह्यं दत्त्वा॒ व्रजत ब्रह्मलोक॒म् ॥१॥
19.71.e: Let my libations, giving boons, adoring, further the Twice-born's song that honours Soma. Go ye to Brahma's world having enriched me with life and breath, with children and with cattle, with fame and wealth, and with a Brāhman's lustre.

19.72.d: य॒स्मात् को॒शाद् उद॒भराम वे॒दं त॒स्मिन्न् अन्त॒र् अ॒व दध्म एनम् । कृत॒म् इष्टं॒ ब्र॒ह्मणो वीर्ये॑ण ते॒न मा देवास् त॒पसावतेह॒ ॥१॥
19.72.e: Within the chest whence we before extracted the bunch of grass, this do we now deposit. Wrought is the sacrifice by power of Brahma. Through this assist me here, ye God, with Fervour.

20.1.d: इ॒न्द्र त्वा वृषभं॒ वयं॒ सुते॒ सो॒मे हवामहे । स॒ पाहि म॒ध्वो अ॒न्धसः ॥१॥
20.1.e: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma hath been pressed. Drink of the sweetly-flavoured juice.

20.1.d: म॒रुतो य॒स्य हि॒ क्ष॒ये पाथा॒ दिवो॒ विमहसः । स॒ सुगोपा॒तमो ज॒नः ॥२॥
20.1.e: The best of guardian hath the man within whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

20.1.d: उक्षा॒न्नाय वशा॒न्नाय सो॒मपृष्ठाय वेध॒से । स्तो॒मैर् विधेमाग्न॒ये ॥३॥
20.1.e: Let us serve Agni with our hyms, Sage who consumeth ox and cow, Who beareth Soma on his back.

20.2.d: मरु॒तः पोत्रा॒त् सुष्टु॒भः स्वर्का॒द् ऋतु॒ना सो॒मं पिबन्तु ॥१॥
20.2.e: Let the Maruts drink Trishtups from the Potar's cup, according to the season Soma from heaven.

20.2.d: अग्नि॒र् आ॒ग्नीध्रात् सुष्टु॒भः स्वर्का॒द् ऋतु॒ना सो॒मं पिबतु ॥२॥
20.2.e: Let Agni from the Kindler's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.

20.2.d: इ॒न्द्रो ब्रह्मा॒ ब्रा॒ह्मणात् सुष्टु॒भः स्वर्का॒द् ऋतु॒ना सो॒मं पिबतु ॥३॥
20.2.e: Let Indra the Brāhman from the Brāhman's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.

20.2.d: देवो॒ द्रविणोदाः॒ पोत्रा॒त् सुष्टु॒भः स्वर्का॒द् ऋतु॒ना सो॒मं पिबतु ॥४॥
20.2.e: Let the God, Granter of Wealth, from the Potar's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.

20.3.d: आ॒ याहि सुषुमा॒ हि॒ त इ॒न्द्र सो॒मं पि॒बा इम॒म् । ए॒दं॒ बर्हिः॒ सदो म॒म ॥१॥
20.3.e: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee: O Indra, drink this Soma here. Seat thee on this my sacred grass.

20.3.d: आ॒ त्वा ब्रह्मयु॒जा ह॒री व॒हताम् इन्द्र केशि॒ना । उ॒प ब्र॒ह्माणि नः शृणु ॥२॥
20.3.e: Let both thy bay steeds, yoked by prayer long-maned, O Indra, bring thee nigh.

20.3.d: ब्रह्मा॒णस् त्वा वयं॒ युजा॒ सोमपा॒म् इन्द्र सोमि॒नः । सुता॒वन्तो हवामहे ॥३॥
20.3.e: We Soma-bearing Brāhmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, who have pressed the juice.

20.4.d: आ॒ नो याहि सुता॒वतो ऽस्मा॒कं सुष्टुती॒र् उ॒प । पि॒बा सु॒ शिप्रिन्न् अ॒न्धसः ॥१॥
20.4.e: Come unto us who poured the juice, come hither to our eulogies. Drink of the juice, O fair of face.

20.4.d: आ॒ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्यो॒र् अ॒नु गा॒त्रा वि॒ धावतु । गृभाय॒ जिह्व॒या म॒धु ॥२॥
20.4.e: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it run. Take with thy tongue the pleasant drink.

20.4.d: स्वादु॒ष् टे अस्तु संसु॒दे म॒धुमान् तन्वे॑ त॒व । सो॒मः श॒म् अस्तु ते हृदे॒ ॥३॥
20.4.e: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice. Sweet be the Soma to thy heart.

20.5.d: अय॒म् उ त्वा विचर्षणे ज॒नीर् इवाभि॒ सं॒वृतः । प्र॒ सो॒म इन्द्र सर्पतु ॥१॥
20.5.e: Like women, let this Soma juice invested with its raiment, glide.. Most active Indra, close to thee.

20.5.d: तुविग्री॒वो वपो॒दरः सुबाहु॒र् अ॒न्धसो स॒दे । इ॒न्द्रो वृत्रा॒णि जिघ्नते ॥२॥
20.5.e: Mighty in bulk, strong-necked, stout-armed in the wild rapture. of the juice Doth Indra smite the foemen dead.

20.5.d: इ॒न्द्र प्रे॒हि पुर॒स् त्वं॒ वि॒श्वस्ये॒शान ओ॒जसा । वृत्रा॒णि वृत्रहं जहि ॥३॥
20.5.e: Indra, advance, go forward thou who by thy might art Lord of all. Slay, Vritra-slayer slay thy foes.

20.5.d: दीर्घ॒स् ते अस्त्व् अङ्कुशो॒ ये॒ना व॒सु प्रय॒छसि । य॒जमानाय सुन्वते॒ ॥४॥
20.5.e: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest treasure unto- him Who pours the juice and worships thee.

20.5.d: अयं॒ त इन्द्र सो॒मो नि॒पूतो अ॒धि बर्हि॒षि । ए॒हीम् अस्य॒ द्र॒वा पि॒ब ॥५॥
20.5.e: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred. grass. Run hither, come and drink thereof.

20.5.d: शा॒चिगो शा॒चिपूजनायं॒ र॒णाय ते सुतः॒ । आ॒खण्डल प्र॒ हूयसे ॥६॥
20.5.e: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Ākhandala!

20.5.d: य॒स् ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात् प्र॒णपात् कुण्डपा॒य्यः । न्य् अ॑स्मिन् दध्र आ॒ म॒नः ॥७॥
20.5.e: To Kundapāyya, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish, to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.

20.6.d: इ॒न्द्र त्वा वृषभं॒ वयं॒ सुते॒ सो॒मे हवामहे । स॒ पाहि म॒ध्वो अ॒न्धसः ॥१॥
20.6.e: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma is ex- pressed. So drink thou of the savoury juice.

20.6.d: इ॒न्द्र क्रतुवि॒दं सुतं॒ सो॒मं हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पि॒बा॒ वृषस्व ता॒तृपिम् ॥२॥
20.6.e: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-confering Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.

20.6.d: इ॒न्द्र प्र॒ णो धिता॒वानं यज्ञं॒ वि॒श्वेभिर् देवे॒भिर् । तिर॒ स्तवान विश्पते ॥३॥
20.6.e: Indra, with all the Gods promote our wealth-bestowing sacrifice, Thou highly-lauded Lord of men.

20.6.d: इ॒न्द्र सो॒माः सुता॒ इमे॒ त॒व प्र॒ यन्ति सत्पते । क्ष॒यं चन्द्रा॒स इ॒न्दवः ॥४॥
20.6.e: Lord of the brave, to thee proceed these drops of Soma juice expressed, The bright drops to thy dwelling-place.

20.6.d: दधिष्वा॒ जठ॒रे सुतं॒ सो॒मम् इन्द्र व॒रेण्यम् । त॒व द्युक्षा॒स इ॒न्दवः ॥५॥
20.6.e: Within thy belly, Indra take Soma the juice most excellent: The heavenly drops belong to thee.

20.6.d: गि॒र्वणः पाहि॒ नः सुतं॒ म॒धोर् धा॒राभिर् अज्यसे । इ॒न्द्र त्वा॒दातम् इ॒द् य॒शः ॥६॥
20.6.e: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns: with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Our glory, Indra, is thy gift.

20.6.d: अभि॒ द्युम्ना॒नि वनि॒न इ॒न्द्रं सचन्ते अ॒क्षिता । पीत्वी॒ सो॒मस्य वावृधे ॥७॥
20.6.e: To Indra go the treasures of the worshipper which never fail: He drinks the Soma and is strong.

20.6.d: अर्वाव॒तो न आ॒ गहि पराव॒तश् च वृत्रहन् । इमा॒ जुषस्व नो गि॒रः ॥८॥
20.6.e: From far away, from near at hand, O Vritra-slayer, come to us: Accept the songs we sing to thee.

20.6.d: य॒द् अन्तरा॒ पराव॒तम् अर्वाव॒तं च हूय॒से । इ॒न्द्रेह॒ त॒त आ॒ गहि ॥९॥

20.7.d: उ॒द् घे॒द् अभि॒ श्रुता॒मघं वृषभं॒ न॒र्यापसम् । अ॒स्तारम् एषि सूर्य ॥१॥
20.7.e: Sūrya, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man:

20.7.d: न॒व यो॒ नवतिं॒ पु॒रो बिभे॒द बाह्वो॑जसा । अ॒हिं च वृत्रहा॒वधीत् ॥२॥
20.7.e: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead.

20.7.d: स॒ न इ॒न्द्रः शिवः॒ स॒खा॒श्वावद् गो॒मद् य॒वमत् । उरु॒धारेव दोहते ॥३॥
20.7.e: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

20.7.d: इ॒न्द्र क्रतुवि॒दं सुतं॒ सो॒मं हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पिबा॒ वृषस्व ता॒तृपिम् ॥४॥
20.7.e: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-conferring Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.

20.8.d: एवा॒ पाहि प्रत्न॒था म॒न्दतु त्वा श्रुधि॒ ब्र॒ह्म वावृध॒स्वोत॒ गीर्भिः॒ । आविः॒ सू॒र्यं कृणुहि॒ पीपिही॒षो जहि॒ श॒त्रूंर् अभि॒ गा॒ इन्द्र तृन्धि ॥१॥
20.8.e: Drink as of old, and let the draught delight thee: hear thou my prayer and let our songs exalt thee. Make the Sun visible, make food abundant: slaughter the foes,. pierce through and free the cattle.

20.8.d: अर्वा॒ङ् ए॒हि सो॒मकामं त्वाहुर् अयं॒ सुत॒स् त॒स्य पिबा म॒दाय । उरुव्य॒चा जठ॒र आ॒ वृषस्व पिते॒व नः शृणुहि हूय॒मानः ॥२॥
20.8.e: Come to us; they have called thee Soma-lover. Here is the pressed juice: drink thereof for rapture. Widely-capacious, pour it down within thee, and invocated hear us like a father.

20.8.d: आ॒पूर्णो अस्य कल॒शः स्वा॒हा से॒क्तेव को॒शं सिषिचे पि॒बध्यै । स॒म् उ प्रिया॒ आ॒ववृत्रन् म॒दाय प्रदक्षिणि॒द् अभि॒ सो॒मास इ॒न्द्रम् ॥३॥
20.8.e: Full is his chalice. Blessing! Like a pourer I have filled up the vessel for his drinking. Presented on the right, dear Soma juices have brought us Indra,. to rejoice him, hither.

20.9.d: तं॒ वो दस्म॒म् ऋतीष॒हम् व॒सोर् मन्दान॒म् अ॒न्धसः । अभि॒ वत्सं॒ न॒ स्व॒सरेषु धेन॒व इ॒न्द्रं गीर्भि॒र् नवामहे ॥१॥
20.9.e: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.

20.9.d: द्युक्षं॒ सुदा॒नुं त॒विषीभिर् आ॒वृतं गिरिं॒ न॒ पुरुभो॒जसम् । क्षुम॒न्तं वा॒जं शति॒नं सहस्रि॒णं मक्षू॒ गो॒मन्तम् ईमहे ॥२॥
20.9.e: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, moun- tain-like, in precious things Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

20.9.d: त॒त् त्वा यामि सुवी॒र्यं त॒द् ब्र॒ह्म पूर्व॒चित्तये । ये॒ना य॒तिभ्यो भृ॒गवे ध॒ने हिते॒ ये॒न प्र॒स्कण्वम् आ॒विथ ॥३॥
20.9.e: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer, Wherewith thou helpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.

20.9.d: ये॒ना समुद्र॒म् अ॒सृजो मही॒र् अप॒स् त॒द् इन्द्र वृ॒ष्णि ते श॒वः । सद्यः॒ सो॒ अस्य महिमा॒ न॒ संन॒शे यं॒ क्षोणी॒र् अनुचक्रदे॒ ॥४॥
20.9.e: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is. thy hero strength. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds. have called aloud.

20.10.d: उ॒द् उ ते॒ म॒धुमत्तमा गि॒र स्तो॒मास ईरते । सत्राजि॒तो धनसा॒ अ॒क्षितोतयो वाजय॒न्तो र॒था इव ॥१॥
20.10.e: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise as- cend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing aid.

20.10.d: क॒ण्वा इव भृ॒गवः सू॒र्या इव वि॒श्वम् इ॒द् धीत॒म् आनशुः । इ॒न्द्रं स्तो॒मेभिर् मह॒यन्त आय॒वः प्रिय॒मेधासो अस्वरन् ॥२॥
20.10.e: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent to win. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.
